description: Watch a goal's tools, or the services a small tool depends on, using stored public facts, never a verdict. No live inspection. Requires an agent key or an account token with record:read in Authorization; get a key: POST https://interfacedelta.com/api/v1/agent-keys. 1–50 tools; default lifetime 30 days, maximum 90 days; at most 20 active watches and 50 creations per principal per UTC day; creation costs one Record API request per tool; polling, listing and stopping consume none; polling at most once per 60 seconds per principal and watchId, default page 20, maximum 50, replay ceiling 30 days, nextPollMs 900000. Poll goal.tools.changed using the returned watchId. Null cursor starts at watch startedAt. Expiry or stop cuts off new changes; earlier changes remain replayable for seven days, then a typed watch error is returned. Polling delivery only.
name: watch_tools
title: Watch tools
